finding: Original native10 admits a false smooth ambient conclusion if two-sided product data may be TOP rather than smooth.
ambient: M=(R/Z)_x×(R/Z)_y×[0,1], smooth orientable compact connected, with circle fibers x and base annulus (y,t).
smooth_embedding_proof: A_s(0)=0,A_s(1)=1 and ∂rA_s=a+2(1-a)r>0 for r>0. Equality f(s,r)=f(s′,r′) forces s=s′ then r=r′. Its s-derivative has x component1; its r-derivative has components (0,ε(1-2r),a+2(1-a)r). For r>0 the last component is positive; at r=0,a=0 the y component is ε≠0. Thus rank2 everywhere. Compactness gives a smooth embedding. It meets ∂M only at its two source boundary circles.
TOP_product: R(s,t)=(-a(s)+sqrt(a(s)²+4(1-a(s))t))/(2(1-a(s))) is continuous for all(s,t), strictly inverts A_s, and is0 at t0,1 at t1. Put q(s,t)=εR(s,t)(1-R(s,t)). Hλ([x],[y],t)=([x],[y-λq(x,t)],t) is a jointly continuous ambient isotopy of homeomorphisms, inverse obtained by addingλq. It fixes ∂M pointwise. H1 sends f(s,r) to([s],0,A_s(r)). A TOP two-sided product is explicitly C(s,r,u)=([s],[u+εr(1-r)],A_s(r)), |u|≤δ<1/4. It is a homeomorphism from(S1×I)×[-δ,δ] to its actual product neighborhood, with C(s,r,0)=f(s,r). It is not a smooth embedding at(s0,r0) because its differential there has rank2.
irreducibility: M has cover R²×I by integral translations. Any smooth embedded sphere lifts since S2 is simply connected. Smooth Schoenflies in R3 gives a ball for the lift; the ball lies strictly between the boundary planes, since each plane lies in the connected unbounded component away from that sphere. Distinct translates of the lifted sphere are disjoint (injectivity of the original sphere). Their balls are disjoint or nested; nonzero-translation nesting would iterate and contradict boundedness. Thus the ball projects injectively to a ball in M. This uses only the root-ready smoothSchoenflies supplier/CC, available under original fullAC.
incompressibility: The generator of π1(f(S1×I)) has x-coordinate degree1, so its inclusion into π1(M)=Z² is injective. Every essential simple circle in an annulus has nonzero generator class, so no embedded compressing disk can exist, even topologically.
boundary_incompressibility: Every essential proper embedded annulus arc spans its two boundary components (a same-boundary-component simple arc cuts off a disk, as can be seen by a lift to the strip). Its endpoints here lie in different components t0,t1 of ∂M. No connected arcβ in ∂M joins them, so no boundary-compressing disk exists, even topologically.
not_boundary_parallel: A product between this connected annulus and a subsurface of ∂M would have one connected annular boundary subsurface lying in one component of ∂M. Its two side annuli would connect both boundary circles of f to that same component, impossible since f meets the two different components t0,t1. Thus it is not boundary-parallel even topologically.
tangency_invariant: At r0, Tf=span{∂x,ε∂y+a(s)∂t}. It equals T∂M exactly when a(s)=0, namely the single point s0. At r1 it is transverse. A boundary-preserving smooth diffeomorphism carries T∂M onto T∂M, so equality Tf=T∂M is preserved pointwise and its image on that boundary circle remains a nonempty proper subset (indeed one point).
vertical_obstruction: A vertical annulus is a union of x-fibers. Each boundary circle is one full fiber. Translation in x preserves both the annulus and ambient boundary, so tangency along each such boundary fiber is either everywhere or nowhere. It cannot have a one-point tangency subset.
horizontal_obstruction: A horizontal surface is transverse to every fiber. At a point with Tf=T∂M, the fiber tangent lies in that tangent plane, so transversality fails. Hence it has no boundary tangency points.
conclusion: This smooth essential TOP-two-sided annulus satisfies every broad input of original native10 in this actual smooth Seifert manifold but cannot be carried to a vertical or horizontal surface by any boundary-preserving smooth diffeomorphism, hence by no ordinary smooth ambient isotopy. This is a necessary truth-repair finding, not a choice-based or open-problem replacement.
smooth_product_implies_neat_proof: For an actual full-rank smooth product embedding c:F×(-δ,δ)→M with c(p,0)=p at p∈∂F, let q≥0 define ∂M locally. The two directions tangent to ∂F×(-δ,δ) admit both signs, so q∘c has derivative0 on their2-plane at(p,0), because it has its minimum0 there. Fullrank3 of dc makes dq∘dc nonzero; its inward source normal derivative is therefore strictly positive. That direction includes the inward direction of F at product coordinate0, proving neatness. A merelyTOP product C above lacks fullrank3 and does not imply this.
native3_disposition: Full original proper-annulus scope requires explicit TOP-to-smooth witness/product accounting; do not infer neatness from generic proper map. Candidate broad neatification supplies TOP product transport, but no automatic original acceptance is claimed.
native4_disposition: The reviewer disk z↦(((3-|z|²)/2)z,exp(i(1-|z|²))) has the same meridian boundary as the neat standard disk and has tangent plane equal ambient boundary plane along its whole boundary. It is smooth embedded (base radial derivative positive for r<1; fiber derivative nonzero at r1), boundary-preimage proper and TOP two-sided via its continuous graph shear. Thus a smooth ambient version of the unqualified same-boundary meridian-disk clause is false. A smooth embedding-isotopy version, with ambient conclusion on neatinputs, is the proposed necessary repair. Surface topological classification/compression clauses must retain originalinputs and be checked separately.
